outcome: Volume of the rectum receiving 40 Gy (V40-rectum)
Volume of the bladder receiving 40 Gy (V40-bladder)
cohort: Sixty cervical cancer patients treated with volume-modulated arc therapy (VMAT).
finding: Dmax-rectum and Vbladder were significantly negatively correlated with V40-rectum and V40-bladder, respectively, suggesting that maintaining an empty rectum and a filled bladder during radiotherapy can reduce radiation toxicity to these organs.
